name: Named Activation Action Plan v1
purpose: Declare the exact named action, scope, in-scope items, and out-of-scope boundaries required before any supervised activation execution can be separately reviewed.
in_scope: Define supervised activation execution as a named future action
Bind future activation review to chain_id 16661
Identify deploy, stake, mint, and participant actions as possible action classes requiring separate approval
Require dry-run or simulation receipt before readiness can become ready
Require explicit gas, funding, quantity, and participant limits before readiness can become ready
Require irreversible-zone review before readiness can become ready
Require explicit human operator approval before any execution lane may run
out_of_scope: No repeated or autonomous execution loop

target_contracts_or_action_scope.deploy: Target contracts must be named in a later action-specific execution plan before readiness can become ready.
target_contracts_or_action_scope.stake: Staking contract and amount limit must be named in a later action-specific execution plan before readiness can become ready.
target_contracts_or_action_scope.mint: Asset contract, recipient scope, and quantity limit must be named in a later action-specific execution plan before readiness can become ready.
target_contracts_or_action_scope.participant_action: Participant scope, manual review boundary, and pause condition must be named in a later action-specific execution plan before readiness can become ready.
